title: Not a baby
description: A bilingual lesson in which Jill's father insists she come home by half past ten and won't give her the front-door key, while her mother insists she is not a baby and he should. Includes workbook fill-in dialogue, clock times and reflexive-pronoun structure, plus grammar on reflexive pronouns and usual-vs-today sentences. 吉尔的爸爸坚持她必须在10点半前回家、不肯把前门的钥匙给她，而妈妈坚持她不是小孩子、应该给她钥匙。配合教材填空对话、看钟报时和反身代词练习，以及反身代词和「通常……但今天不」的语法练习。
answer_note: The before-listening question has no official key and its answer is labelled suggested. Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 65 key (img/key-063-067.jpg); practice B clock times are constructed from the printed example (9:30 → It's half-past nine) and labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 65 grammar key (PDF viewer pages 498-499). No external sources were used.

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. Does Jill take the key to the front door? 听录音，然后回答问题。吉尔有没有拿到大门的钥匙？
lesson.translation: Listen then answer this question. Does Jill take the key to the front door?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: What are you going to do this evening, Jill?
lines.translation: 今晚你打算干什么，吉尔？

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: I'm going to meet some friends, Dad.
lines.translation: 我打算去看几个朋友，爸爸。

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text:
You mustn't come home late.
You must be home at half past ten.
lines.translation: 你不准回家太晚，你必须在10点半到家。

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: I can't get home so early, Dad!
lines.translation: 这么早我回到了不了家，爸爸！

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Can I have the key to the front door, please?
lines.translation: 我能带上前门的钥匙吗？

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text:
Jill's eighteen years old, Tom.
She's not a baby.
Give her the key.
She always comes home early.
lines.translation: 吉尔都18岁了，汤姆。她不是小孩子了。把钥匙给她吧。她总是早早回家的。

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text:
Here you are.
But you mustn't come home
after a quarter past eleven.
Do you hear?
lines.translation: 拿去。但你不能超过11点1刻回家。听见了吗？

lines.speaker: Mother
lines.text:
That's all right.
Goodbye.
Enjoy yourself!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text:
We always enjoy ourselves, Mum.
Bye-bye.
lines.translation: 我们总是玩得很开心的，妈妈。再见。

lesson.title: Before-listening question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Does Jill take the key to the front door? 听录音，然后回答问题。吉尔有没有拿到大门的钥匙？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue. 根据对话回答问题。
lesson.context: After Mother insists Jill is not a baby and should have the key, Father agrees and says 'Here you are.'

questions.prompt: Does Jill take the key to the front door?
questions.answer: Yes, she does. After her mother insists she is not a baby, her father agrees and gives her the key.

items.title: the key to the front door,
items.text: to the front door 是介词短语，作定语，修饰 key。

items.title: Enjoy yourself!
items.text: 好好玩吧。在 enjoy 这个动词后面往往有一个反身代词，如 yourself, ourselves, himself, herself 等。

lesson.text:
参考译文
父亲：今晚你打算干什么，吉尔？
吉尔：我打算去看几个朋友，爸爸。

父亲：你不准回家太晚，你必须在10点半到家。
吉尔：这么早我回到了不了家，爸爸！

吉尔：我能带上前门的钥匙吗？
父亲：不行，你不能带。

母亲：吉尔都18岁了，汤姆。她不是小孩子了。把钥匙给她吧。她总是早早回家的。
父亲：那么，好吧！

父亲：拿去。但你不能超过11点1刻回家。听见了吗？
吉尔：听见了，爸爸。

吉尔：谢谢，妈妈。
母亲：不用谢。再见。好好玩吧！
吉尔：我们总是玩得很开心的，妈妈。再见。

questions.prompt: I/do my homework/seven thirty/evening
questions.answer: I usually do my homework at seven thirty in the evening, but this evening I'm not going to.

questions.prompt: Linda/get up/six/morning
questions.answer: Linda usually gets up at six in the morning, but this morning she isn't going to.

questions.prompt: he/go to bed/ten/night
questions.answer: He usually goes to bed at ten at night, but tonight he isn't going to.

questions.prompt: they/walk along the beach/six thirty/morning
questions.answer: They usually walk along the beach at six thirty in the morning, but this morning they aren't going to.

questions.prompt: we/eat our lunch/noon every day
questions.answer: We usually eat our lunch at noon every day, but today we aren't going to.

questions.prompt: mother/cook a meal/five/afternoon
questions.answer: Mother usually cooks a meal at five in the afternoon, but this afternoon she isn't going to.

questions.prompt: they/play basketball/four/afternoon
questions.answer: They usually play basketball at four in the afternoon, but this afternoon they aren't going to.

questions.prompt: How old are you? (fifteen) / What can you do at fifteen? (wash my clothes)

questions.prompt: How old are you? (eighteen) / What can you do at eighteen? (go to work)

questions.prompt: How old are you? (sixteen) / What can you do at sixteen? (cook)

questions.prompt: How old are you? (seventeen) / What can you do at seventeen? (type)
